repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-encryption
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin for encryption and the Key Management Service (KMS) client. It registers webex.internal.encryption with a kms child, negotiates the KMS session (with optional certificate-chain enforcement and report-only CA-root trials), fetches and caches keys, encrypts and decrypts text, binary data, and SCRs, downloads encrypted files, and wraps and unwraps KMS messages in service payloads.

task_playbooks.when_to_use: Changing key handling, encryption and decryption, the KMS context negotiation, request batching and retry, certificate validation, or the payload transformer in src/.
task_playbooks.fallback: If a change alters the KMS wire protocol or trust handling, stop and report it; the behavior depends on node-kms and @webex/kms-caroots, which this package does not own.

task_playbooks.when_to_use: Updating the signed Cisco CA-root bundle shipped in assets/ and src/union-bundle.js.
task_playbooks.fallback: Do not hand-edit src/union-bundle.js; it is generated by the refresh script.

task_playbooks.when_to_use: Code changes alter a requirement, the public surface, a dependency, or a pitfall documented in the module spec.
validate_with: Run the Repo Annotation spec-index and manifest checkers through the active installation
task_playbooks.fallback: Leave generated metadata and validation status untouched; validation is run by an independent runtime.

glossary.definition: Key Management Service: the Webex service that issues and stores content keys.
Secure content reference: the key and metadata for one encrypted file, handled through node-scr.
The signed Cisco Trusted Root Store bundle used to validate the KMS certificate chain.

glossary.definition: An error returned inside a decrypted KMS response, surfaced as DryError.
